oil.when: 2006–2007 with the Driver Information Center information and reset buttons
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to RUN but leave the engine off.
Press the information and reset buttons on the Driver Information Center at the same time to open the personalization menu.
Press the information button to scroll until the display shows OIL-LIFE RESET.
Press and hold the reset button until the display shows ACKNOWLEDGED.
Turn the key to LOCK. If the CHANGE OIL SOON message comes back at the next start, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2006 and 2007 owner's manuals.

notes: If the oil life system is ever reset by accident, change the oil within 3,000 miles of the last change.
